nodes.label: Base Image Dependency Installer
nodes.rationale: Installs three parallel ffmpeg builds (5.0, 7.0, 8.0) per architecture so camera-specific regressions can be worked around by selecting a version at runtime. Layers Intel GPU support from multiple sources: jammy repo for legacy libmfx1, trixie for libva2/libvpl2/libmfx-gen1.2 for Battlemage, and pinned .deb releases for both legacy and current compute-runtime plus NPU level-zero drivers. Symlinks iHD_drv_video.so to xe_drv_video.so because Battlemage uses the xe kernel driver while the VA-API driver is still iHD.

nodes.label: Pinned Upstream Artifact Fetching
nodes.rationale: Nearly every accelerator and codec dependency is fetched as a pinned GitHub release URL (edgetpu, ffmpeg builds, compute-runtime, level-zero, NPU driver, hailort, memryx, s6-overlay) instead of from distro repos, because the required versions are newer or not packaged at all. The cost is manual version bumps; the benefit is reproducible builds independent of Debian's release cadence.
